Use a hexadecimal color style to print text in orange, for example `console.print("Hello", style="#FFA500")`. See [Styles](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst) for color options, and ask usage questions in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
